identification: Photos (reviewed, zoomed): about 40 circulated Australian 12-sided 50c commemoratives (Cook 1970, Jubilee 1977, Wedding 1981, Games 1982, 1988, 2000s) in a clear box. I looked for round 1966 silver 50c and saw none (all are dodecagonal).

entries.note: Bulk lot of 70 Australian commemorative 50c coins, some doubles.

searches_tried: | chrome: eBay AU sold: australian 50 cent coins bulk lot commemorative circulated
viewing_check: Armitage estimate $25-35, current bid $20 (as of 8 Nov 2026). Only value above face (about $20 for 40) would come from a 1966 round silver 50c hiding under others (such lots sold A$410 for 11 on 20 Sep 2026, item 377507290940, and A$530.70 for 17 on 7 Nov 2026, item 137893646794). None visible in the photo, so treat as face value plus a little.
